description.value: At 7th level, the necromancer gains a form of blindsight that can detect living and undead creatures. The necromancer can only distinguish if the target is living or undead; constructs, oozes and equipment carried by the targets cannot be seen. The targets appear as semi-colorful silhouettes, and can be seen up to a range of 60 feet. Activating or deactivating this ability is a swift action, and turns the necromancer's eyes black or dull grey. Spells that blind the necromancer have a 50% chance of negating this form of blindsight; blindfolds and shades do not block life sight, but do block normal vision as usual. Using lifesight penalizes Charisma skill checks by -2 (except Intimidate). At 13th level the range increases from 60 feet to 120 feet.
